detailed_description: The Currency Converter performs browser-side conversions using the local currency data bundled with the app. You can enter a non-negative amount, choose one source currency and one target currency from grouped dropdowns, swap the two selections, and see the converted amount, exchange rate, inverse rate, and a quick conversion table for common amounts. The display formats fiat currencies with two decimals and BTC/ETH with eight decimals. The tool does not call real-time exchange-rate APIs, provide historical rates, compare multiple target currencies at once, show bid/ask spreads or volatility, export JSON, expose an API endpoint, or guarantee financial-grade accuracy.
usage_steps: Enter a non-negative amount in the amount field.
Choose the source currency from the From dropdown.
Choose the target currency from the To dropdown.
Use the swap button if you want to reverse the two selected currencies.
Review the converted amount, exchange rate, inverse rate, and quick conversion table.
usage_examples: Convert a sample USD amount to EUR using the app's local rate table.
Swap two selected currencies to compare the direct and inverse rate display.
Check quick conversion rows for common amounts like 10, 100, or 1000.
Format a BTC or ETH conversion with eight decimal places for rough reference.
